ns2:course.label: Spain and Portugal to 1808
ns2:course.description: Introduction to the history of the Iberian peninsula to 1808. After a brief overview of Roman and Visigoth Iberia, the course will study the cultural, technological and intellectual accomplishments of Moorish Iberia and the imperial expansion of Christian Spain and Portugal in the early modern period. Prerequisite: One year of college history of consent of instructor.
